summary: Detach provisional storage attachments when registration readiness or capacity refuses them, including undersized iSCSI cleanup. API impact: existing contract; guide impact: none.

guide.reason: Operator-visible refusal text is unchanged; cleanup is an internal Core recovery correction.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Behavior fix on the implemented storage-register and storage-update paths without a new endpoint or payload change.

state.reason: Storage registrations, mounts, sessions and ownership receipts remain Core-owned; this fix only completes rollback of refused provisional attachments.
state.record: Pool master managed-vms journal plus Core-private iscsi-owners, mount units and initiator node state under the agent state directory. Fresh Controllers recover accepted repositories through inventory; refused preparations must leave no durable attachment.

verification.method: Focused vmhost/agent/protocol race tests including TestManagedStoragePrepareRollsBackCapacityRefusal, TestManagedStoragePrepareReportsUncertainCapacityCleanup and TestPrepareISCSIRollbackRemovesEngineOwnerReceipt. Disposable-lab undersized iSCSI registration returned insufficient free storage including reserve with no leftover session, node, mount unit or ownership receipt.
